outcomes.title: Business continuity and recovery achieved
outcomes.description: Disaster-affected businesses have resumed operations, restored revenue streams, and rebuilt customer bases, with targeted support provided to address barriers to business recovery across all sectors.

activities.title: Deliver business recovery advisory services
activities.description: Provide specialist business advisory services to disaster-affected businesses, including financial planning, insurance navigation, supply chain restoration, and marketing strategy support.

activities.title: Administer business recovery grants and concessional loans
activities.description: Distribute financial assistance to eligible businesses through grants and low-interest loan programs designed to support business restart, equipment replacement, and working capital needs.

activities.title: Facilitate shared temporary business premises
activities.description: Establish temporary business hubs or shared workspace facilities where displaced businesses can resume operations while permanent premises are repaired or rebuilt.

indicators.title: Business operational status post-disaster
indicators.description: Percentage of disaster-affected businesses that have resumed full operations, are partially operational, or have permanently closed, tracked by industry sector and business size.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Business recovery tracking survey administered quarterly to registered businesses in affected areas, supplemented by ABR data on business registrations and cancellations.

indicators.title: Business revenue recovery levels
indicators.description: Average revenue levels of disaster-affected businesses as a proportion of pre-disaster turnover, tracked by industry sector over time.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Confidential business survey collecting revenue data at 6-monthly intervals, with aggregate analysis by sector and comparison to pre-disaster ABS business statistics.

indicators.title: Business confidence in recovery trajectory
indicators.description: Self-assessed confidence levels of business operators regarding their recovery trajectory and future business viability.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Business confidence survey using standardised sentiment measures, administered quarterly with results analysed by sector, size, and geographic location.

outcomes.title: Employment rates restored to pre-disaster levels
outcomes.description: Employment levels across the disaster-affected area have recovered to pre-disaster rates, with displaced workers re-employed and job losses from business closures offset by new employment opportunities.

activities.title: Implement local employment and skills matching programs
activities.description: Establish employment support services that match displaced workers with available positions, including roles in the rebuilding and recovery sector, and provide retraining where needed.

activities.title: Create recovery-related employment opportunities
activities.description: Maximise local employment in recovery and rebuilding activities through local procurement requirements, apprenticeship programs, and community employment initiatives.

indicators.title: Local unemployment and underemployment rates
indicators.description: Unemployment and underemployment rates in the disaster-affected area compared to pre-disaster levels and regional averages.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: ABS labour force statistics at the local government area level, supplemented by Centrelink data on income support recipients, analysed quarterly.

indicators.title: Employment services utilisation and placement rates
indicators.description: Uptake of employment support services by disaster-affected workers and the rate of successful job placement outcomes.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Employment service provider data on client registrations, services delivered, and placement outcomes, reported monthly with demographic disaggregation.

outcomes.title: Economic diversity maintained and enhanced
outcomes.description: The local economy has maintained or improved its diversity of industries, employment types, and income sources, reducing vulnerability to future economic shocks from disaster or other causes.

activities.title: Support economic diversification initiatives
activities.description: Invest in programs that encourage the development of new industries, business types, and economic activities that broaden the local economic base and reduce sectoral concentration risk.

activities.title: Conduct economic resilience planning
activities.description: Facilitate local economic resilience planning that assesses economic vulnerability to future shocks and develops strategies for building a more diverse and adaptable economy.

indicators.title: Economic diversity index
indicators.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman or equivalent diversity index measuring the concentration and diversity of local economic activity across industry sectors.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Analysis of ABS National Accounts data and business registration statistics at local government area level, calculated annually.

indicators.title: New business formation rates
indicators.description: Rate of new business registrations in the disaster-affected area, including analysis of industry sector diversity among new businesses.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Australian Business Register data on new registrations in the affected area, analysed quarterly by industry sector and compared to pre-disaster trends.

outcomes.title: Access to essential goods and services restored
outcomes.description: Community members have reliable access to essential goods and services including food, fuel, banking, postal services, and retail, with supply chains restored and service gaps addressed.

activities.title: Facilitate essential service restoration and gap-filling
activities.description: Work with government and private sector providers to restore essential services and implement alternative arrangements where permanent service restoration is delayed.

activities.title: Support local retail and service sector recovery
activities.description: Assist local retail businesses and service providers to resume operations through financial assistance, temporary premises, and community buy-local campaigns.

indicators.title: Essential service availability
indicators.description: Availability and accessibility of essential goods and services in the disaster-affected area, measured against a defined list of essential services needed for community functioning.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Essential services audit conducted quarterly, mapping availability and accessibility of defined essential services against community need benchmarks.

indicators.title: Community satisfaction with goods and services access
indicators.description: Community members' satisfaction with their ability to access everyday goods and services without unreasonable difficulty or additional cost.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Community access survey administered biannually, measuring satisfaction with accessibility, availability, and affordability of essential goods and services.

outcomes.title: Financial security for individuals and households
outcomes.description: Disaster-affected individuals and households have achieved financial stability, with disaster-related debts managed, income streams restored, and access to appropriate financial services and support.

activities.title: Provide financial counselling and literacy support
activities.description: Fund free financial counselling services for disaster-affected individuals and families to help them manage disaster-related financial pressures, navigate insurance claims, and plan for recovery.

activities.title: Administer personal hardship and recovery grants
activities.description: Deliver financial assistance programs including emergency relief payments, recovery grants, and longer-term financial support to individuals and households experiencing disaster-related financial hardship.

activities.title: Coordinate financial hardship provisions with institutions
activities.description: Liaise with banks, utilities, insurers, and other financial institutions to ensure appropriate hardship provisions are available and accessible to disaster-affected customers.

indicators.title: Household financial stress indicators
indicators.description: Levels of financial stress among disaster-affected households measured through indicators including mortgage arrears, utility disconnections, and reliance on emergency relief.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Financial stress survey administered to disaster-affected households at 6-monthly intervals, supplemented by utility and financial institution hardship data.

indicators.title: Financial counselling service utilisation and outcomes
indicators.description: Number of disaster-affected individuals accessing financial counselling services and the outcomes achieved including debt resolution, insurance settlement, and financial plan establishment.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Financial counselling service data on client numbers, presenting issues, and resolution outcomes, reported quarterly with demographic analysis.

outcomes.title: Supply chain stability restored
outcomes.description: Supply chains critical to the local economy and community have been restored, with businesses and essential services able to reliably source inputs and deliver outputs to customers and markets.

activities.title: Map and address critical supply chain disruptions
activities.description: Identify critical supply chain vulnerabilities and disruptions affecting the disaster-affected area and implement targeted interventions to restore supply chain functioning.

activities.title: Support local supply chain diversification
activities.description: Assist businesses to diversify their supply chains to reduce reliance on single suppliers or transport routes that may be vulnerable to future disruption.

indicators.title: Critical supply chain disruption status
indicators.description: Number and severity of ongoing supply chain disruptions affecting businesses and essential services in the disaster-affected area.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Supply chain disruption monitoring through business surveys and key informant reports from major employers and service providers, collected monthly.

indicators.title: Business-reported supply chain reliability
indicators.description: Business operators' assessment of the reliability and adequacy of their supply chains compared to pre-disaster performance.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Business survey incorporating supply chain reliability questions, administered quarterly as part of broader business recovery monitoring.

outcomes.title: Business confidence and investment restored
outcomes.description: Business and investor confidence in the disaster-affected area has recovered, demonstrated by sustained investment levels, business expansion plans, and positive economic sentiment indicators.

activities.title: Promote the area as open for business and investment
activities.description: Implement marketing and investment attraction campaigns that communicate the area's recovery progress, business opportunities, and competitive advantages to potential investors.

activities.title: Facilitate business networking and confidence-building events
activities.description: Organise business forums, networking events, and economic development workshops that bring business leaders together to share recovery experiences and explore growth opportunities.

indicators.title: Business confidence index
indicators.description: Local business confidence levels measured through survey-based sentiment indicators covering current trading conditions, future outlook, and investment intentions.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Local business confidence survey administered quarterly using questions aligned with national business confidence surveys for benchmarking purposes.

indicators.title: Investment and development activity levels
indicators.description: Value and volume of development applications, building approvals, and capital investment in the disaster-affected area compared to pre-disaster trends.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Local government development application and building approval data analysed quarterly, supplemented by investment inquiry tracking from economic development agencies.

outcomes.title: Agricultural sector recovery achieved
outcomes.description: Agricultural enterprises have recovered productive capacity, with farm infrastructure rebuilt, livestock and crops re-established, and agricultural supply chains restored to support viable farming operations.

activities.title: Deliver agricultural recovery grants and technical support
activities.description: Provide financial assistance and specialist agronomic advisory services to disaster-affected farmers to support farm infrastructure repair, livestock replacement, and crop re-establishment.

activities.title: Support farm mental health and resilience programs
activities.description: Fund targeted mental health and wellbeing support programs for farming families experiencing compounding stress from disaster impacts on their livelihoods and properties.

activities.title: Facilitate agricultural industry coordination and knowledge sharing
activities.description: Bring together farmers, industry bodies, and research organisations to share recovery knowledge, coordinate replanting schedules, and plan for long-term agricultural resilience.

indicators.title: Agricultural production recovery levels
indicators.description: Agricultural output in the disaster-affected area as a proportion of pre-disaster production levels, measured by value and volume across major commodity types.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Agricultural production data from ABS agricultural surveys and industry bodies, analysed annually with comparison to pre-disaster production baselines.

indicators.title: Farm infrastructure and capacity restoration
indicators.description: Proportion of disaster-damaged farm infrastructure including fencing, water systems, machinery sheds, and irrigation that has been repaired or replaced.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Farm infrastructure recovery survey administered to affected agricultural properties at 6-monthly intervals, tracking repair status across infrastructure categories.

indicators.title: Farmer wellbeing and recovery confidence
indicators.description: Self-reported wellbeing and recovery confidence levels of disaster-affected farming families, including financial stress, mental health, and outlook indicators.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Farmer wellbeing survey using validated instruments, administered annually through agricultural networks and extension services with confidential reporting.

outcomes.title: Tourism sector recovery achieved
outcomes.description: The tourism industry in the disaster-affected area has recovered, with visitor numbers, accommodation occupancy, and tourism revenue returning to viable levels and the area's tourism reputation restored.

activities.title: Implement tourism recovery marketing campaigns
activities.description: Deliver targeted marketing campaigns to restore visitor confidence, communicate that the area is open for tourism, and promote unique recovery-related visitor experiences.

activities.title: Support tourism operators to rebuild capacity
activities.description: Provide grants, training, and business advisory support to tourism operators to repair facilities, update offerings, and rebuild their businesses to be competitive and sustainable.

indicators.title: Visitor numbers and tourism revenue
indicators.description: Visitor numbers, length of stay, and tourism expenditure in the disaster-affected area compared to pre-disaster levels and tourism recovery benchmarks.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Tourism research data from visitor surveys, accommodation occupancy statistics, and regional tourism satellite accounts, analysed quarterly.

indicators.title: Tourism operator viability and confidence
indicators.description: Tourism business operators' assessment of their current viability, bookings pipeline, and confidence in the area's tourism recovery trajectory.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Tourism operator survey administered quarterly, collecting data on occupancy rates, forward bookings, revenue trends, and business confidence levels.

outcomes.title: Local economic development opportunities leveraged
outcomes.description: The recovery process has been used as an opportunity to invest in longer-term local economic development, creating new economic opportunities and strengthening the area's competitive advantages.

activities.title: Develop local economic recovery and development strategy
activities.description: Create a strategic economic development plan that leverages recovery investment to build long-term economic opportunities, infrastructure, and competitive advantages for the area.

activities.title: Support innovation and entrepreneurship in recovery
activities.description: Establish programs that support local entrepreneurs and innovators to develop new business opportunities arising from changed conditions and recovery investment flows.

indicators.title: Gross regional product trends
indicators.description: Gross regional product for the disaster-affected area compared to pre-disaster trajectory and comparable regions, measuring overall economic health and growth.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Economic modelling using ABS regional accounts data and local economic indicators, produced annually with trend analysis against pre-disaster projections.

indicators.title: Economic development initiatives established
indicators.description: Number and scale of economic development projects and initiatives that have been established or accelerated as a result of recovery investment and planning.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Economic development project register maintained by local government and regional development agencies, tracking project status, value, and employment outcomes.

outcomes.title: Insurance and financial assistance processes completed
outcomes.description: Insurance claims have been resolved fairly and efficiently, government financial assistance has been distributed to eligible recipients, and disputes have been managed through appropriate resolution mechanisms.

activities.title: Provide insurance advocacy and navigation support
activities.description: Fund independent insurance advocacy services to assist disaster-affected residents and businesses to navigate the insurance claims process and resolve disputes.

activities.title: Streamline government financial assistance delivery
activities.description: Simplify and expedite government grant and financial assistance application and assessment processes to reduce administrative burden on disaster-affected applicants.

indicators.title: Insurance claim resolution rates and timeliness
indicators.description: Proportion of disaster-related insurance claims resolved and average time to settlement, with analysis of disputed and declined claims.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Insurance industry data from the Insurance Council of Australia disaster statistics, supplemented by community insurance experience surveys conducted quarterly.

indicators.title: Government assistance distribution rates
indicators.description: Proportion of eligible applicants who have received government financial assistance, average processing times, and any identified gaps in assistance eligibility.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Government grant program administrative data on applications received, processed, approved, and paid, analysed monthly with demographic and geographic disaggregation.

outcomes.title: Workforce skills and capacity developed
outcomes.description: The local workforce has been upskilled and diversified through recovery-related training and development, building a more adaptable and capable workforce for the future economy.

activities.title: Deliver recovery-related vocational training programs
activities.description: Provide funded training programs in construction, trades, and other skills needed for the rebuilding effort, creating pathways for local residents into recovery employment.

activities.title: Support workforce transition and retraining
activities.description: Assist workers in industries that have not recovered to retrain for employment in growing sectors, including subsidised training, career counselling, and placement support.

indicators.title: Training and skills program participation
indicators.description: Number of disaster-affected residents participating in funded training and skills development programs, with completion rates and qualification outcomes.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Training provider enrolment and completion data aggregated across all recovery-funded skills programs, reported quarterly with demographic analysis.

indicators.title: Employment outcomes from workforce development programs
indicators.description: Employment placement rates and job retention outcomes for participants in recovery-related workforce development programs.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Post-program employment tracking of training participants at 3, 6, and 12 months after program completion, collected through participant surveys and employer verification.

outcomes.title: Small business recovery supported
outcomes.description: Small and micro businesses, which form the backbone of many disaster-affected communities, have received targeted support addressing their specific recovery challenges including limited resources, cash flow pressures, and workforce constraints.

activities.title: Deliver small business mentoring and peer support programs
activities.description: Establish mentoring programs pairing experienced business operators with disaster-affected small business owners, and create peer support networks for shared problem-solving.

activities.title: Provide small business cash flow and working capital support
activities.description: Offer targeted financial assistance addressing the specific cash flow challenges of small businesses including low-interest working capital loans, grant programs, and tax relief measures.

activities.title: Facilitate small business hub and co-working facilities
activities.description: Provide temporary and affordable shared business premises where displaced small businesses can operate while permanent premises are repaired, reducing overhead costs during recovery.

indicators.title: Small business survival and recovery rates
indicators.description: Percentage of disaster-affected small businesses that remain operational at 6, 12, and 24 months post-disaster, with analysis by industry sector and level of damage sustained.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Longitudinal tracking of registered small businesses in the affected area through ABR data and direct survey follow-up at 6-monthly intervals.

indicators.title: Small business owner wellbeing and satisfaction
indicators.description: Self-reported wellbeing levels and satisfaction with recovery support among small business operators in the disaster-affected area.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Small business owner survey covering wellbeing, business recovery progress, and satisfaction with support services, administered biannually.

outcomes.title: Industry diversification pursued
outcomes.description: Recovery planning has deliberately pursued industry diversification to reduce the community's economic vulnerability to single-sector shocks, creating a more balanced and resilient economic structure.

activities.title: Conduct economic opportunity assessment for new industries
activities.description: Commission analysis of potential new industry opportunities for the area based on competitive advantages, infrastructure, workforce skills, and emerging market trends.

activities.title: Attract and incubate new industry sectors
activities.description: Implement targeted industry attraction and incubation programs to establish new economic sectors in the disaster-affected area, including renewable energy, technology, and value-added manufacturing.

indicators.title: Industry sector employment distribution
indicators.description: Distribution of employment across industry sectors in the disaster-affected area, measuring changes in concentration and diversity compared to pre-disaster patterns.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: ABS census and labour force data analysed at local government area level, with industry sector classification at ANZSIC division level, reviewed annually.

indicators.title: New industry establishment outcomes
indicators.description: Number and scale of new industry ventures established in the disaster-affected area as a result of diversification initiatives, including jobs created and investment value.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Economic development agency tracking of industry attraction and incubation outcomes, with verification through business registration and employment data.

outcomes.title: Trade and export activity restored
outcomes.description: Export-oriented businesses and trade links have been restored, with transport infrastructure and logistics chains supporting the movement of goods and services to domestic and international markets.

activities.title: Restore trade infrastructure and logistics
activities.description: Prioritise repair and restoration of transport infrastructure, port facilities, and logistics networks critical to trade and export activity in the affected region.

activities.title: Support exporters to restore market relationships
activities.description: Assist export-oriented businesses to re-establish international market relationships, fulfil delayed orders, and rebuild their reputation with overseas buyers and partners.

indicators.title: Export volume and value recovery
indicators.description: Volume and value of exports from the disaster-affected region compared to pre-disaster levels, tracked by commodity type and destination market.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Trade statistics from ABS international trade data and regional export surveys, analysed quarterly with commodity and market disaggregation.

indicators.title: Trade infrastructure operational status
indicators.description: Operational status and capacity of trade-related infrastructure including roads, rail, ports, and logistics facilities in the affected area.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Infrastructure operational status reports from transport and logistics operators, collected monthly and benchmarked against pre-disaster capacity.

outcomes.title: Economic infrastructure restored
outcomes.description: Infrastructure that underpins economic activity has been repaired or rebuilt, including commercial precincts, industrial facilities, transport networks, and digital connectivity essential for business operations.

activities.title: Prioritise economically critical infrastructure repair
activities.description: Develop and implement a prioritised infrastructure repair program focused on infrastructure with the greatest economic impact, including roads, bridges, power, and telecommunications.

activities.title: Upgrade economic infrastructure during rebuilding
activities.description: Leverage rebuilding investment to upgrade economic infrastructure to modern standards, incorporating improved resilience, digital capability, and energy efficiency.

indicators.title: Economic infrastructure restoration progress
indicators.description: Percentage of damaged economic infrastructure that has been repaired or rebuilt to operational standard, tracked by infrastructure type and economic criticality.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Infrastructure recovery register maintained by coordinating agencies, tracking damage assessment, repair status, and operational capacity for all economic infrastructure assets.

indicators.title: Infrastructure reliability and service levels
indicators.description: Reliability and performance of economic infrastructure services including power, telecommunications, water, and transport compared to pre-disaster service levels.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Infrastructure service performance data from utility providers and transport operators, collected monthly and compared to service level benchmarks.

indicators.title: Business impact of infrastructure disruptions
indicators.description: Business-reported impact of any ongoing infrastructure disruptions on their operations, costs, and recovery progress.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Business impact survey questions included in quarterly business recovery monitoring, measuring infrastructure-related business disruption and cost impacts.

outcomes.title: Income levels restored for affected populations
outcomes.description: Household and individual income levels in the disaster-affected area have recovered to pre-disaster levels, with income inequality not worsened by the disaster and its aftermath.

activities.title: Monitor and address income recovery gaps
activities.description: Track income recovery across different population groups and implement targeted interventions to address persistent income gaps affecting particular demographics or geographic areas.

activities.title: Support income diversification for vulnerable households
activities.description: Provide training, mentoring, and micro-enterprise support to help households that have lost primary income sources develop alternative income streams.

indicators.title: Median household income trends
indicators.description: Median household income in the disaster-affected area compared to pre-disaster levels and comparable non-affected areas, adjusted for inflation.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: ABS census income data supplemented by ATO taxation statistics and Centrelink income support data, analysed at statistical area level annually.

indicators.title: Income inequality indicators
indicators.description: Gini coefficient or equivalent income inequality measure for the disaster-affected area, tracking whether the disaster has widened pre-existing income disparities.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Income distribution analysis using ABS income survey data and taxation statistics, calculated annually with comparison to pre-disaster baseline.

outcomes.title: Commercial property sector recovered
outcomes.description: Commercial and industrial property in the disaster-affected area has been repaired or rebuilt, with occupancy rates, rental values, and property investment levels returning to viable levels.

activities.title: Support commercial property repair and rebuilding
activities.description: Facilitate access to insurance, grants, and financing for commercial and industrial property owners to repair or rebuild damaged premises to appropriate standards.

activities.title: Revitalise commercial precincts and town centres
activities.description: Invest in town centre and commercial precinct revitalisation including streetscaping, public amenities, and place-making initiatives that attract businesses and customers back to affected commercial areas.

indicators.title: Commercial property occupancy rates
indicators.description: Occupancy rates for commercial and industrial properties in the disaster-affected area compared to pre-disaster levels and regional averages.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Commercial property vacancy data from real estate industry databases and local government rates records, analysed quarterly by property type and location.

indicators.title: Commercial property rebuild completion rates
indicators.description: Proportion of damaged commercial and industrial properties that have been repaired or rebuilt to operational standard.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Building permit completion data from local government, cross-referenced with initial damage assessments, tracked monthly until rebuild program completion.

outcomes.title: Economic preparedness for future events enhanced
outcomes.description: Businesses and economic institutions in the area have improved their preparedness for future disaster events, including better business continuity plans, insurance coverage, and supply chain resilience.

activities.title: Promote business continuity planning uptake
activities.description: Deliver business continuity planning workshops and provide templates and tools to help businesses develop and maintain plans for managing future disaster disruptions.

activities.title: Improve disaster insurance literacy and coverage
activities.description: Educate businesses and property owners about disaster insurance options, policy terms, and the importance of adequate coverage, to improve insurance take-up and reduce underinsurance.

activities.title: Build economic resilience networks
activities.description: Establish local business and economic resilience networks that facilitate mutual support, resource sharing, and coordinated response during future disaster events.

indicators.title: Business continuity plan adoption rates
indicators.description: Proportion of businesses in the disaster-affected area that have current business continuity plans addressing natural disaster risks.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Business preparedness survey administered annually, measuring business continuity plan existence, currency, and comprehensiveness across business size and sector categories.

indicators.title: Disaster insurance coverage levels
indicators.description: Proportion of businesses and properties in the disaster-affected area with adequate disaster insurance coverage, including trends in underinsurance and non-insurance.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Insurance coverage survey of businesses and property owners conducted annually, supplemented by aggregated insurer data on policy coverage in the affected area.

indicators.title: Economic resilience network participation
indicators.description: Number of businesses and economic organisations actively participating in local economic resilience networks and mutual support arrangements.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Network membership and activity records maintained by economic resilience network coordinators, reported biannually with participation trend analysis.
